text: There are rows of fruit trees, with apples on the trees. What kind of place is this? Use a full sentence.
This is an orchard.
Before, this was an old cornfield. Now you see a new farm with fruit trees. Describe the new place in a full sentence.
This is a new orchard.
Look at the fruit trees on the card. Find and fix one wrong word.
The trees are in the orchard.
Begin your answer with the words This is. What kind of place has rows of fruit trees?
This is an orchard.
There are corn plants in a new farm field. Name the place and say if it is new or old. Start with This is.
This is a new cornfield.
There are fruit trees on an old farm. Name the place and say if it is new or old. Start with This is.
This is an old orchard.
There is one tall hotel on the card. Describe the hotel in a full sentence.
The hotel is tall.
Before, there was one hotel. Now there are two, and both are tall. Describe the hotels in a full sentence.
The hotels are tall.
The card shows one short building. Find and fix one wrong word.
The building is short.
The card shows one tall building. Start with The building and use a full sentence.
The building is tall.
The card shows three buildings, all short. Start with The buildings and use a full sentence.
The buildings are short.
The card shows one old hotel. Start with The hotel and use a full sentence.
The hotel is old.
Mia has a cat. Tom has a dog. Use but to tell how their pets are different, starting with Mia.
Mia has a cat, but Tom has a dog.
Now each friend has a cat. Talk about Mia and Tom together in one full sentence.
Mia and Tom have cats.
Look at the pet card. Find and fix one wrong word in the sentence.
Mia has a cat.
Mia has a cat and Tom has a dog. Use but to compare their pets. Start with Mia.
Mia has a cat, but Tom has a dog.
Mia's favorite color is red, and Tom's is blue. Compare their favorite colors using but. Start with Mia's.
Mia's favorite color is red, but Tom's is blue.
Mia has a dog and Tom has a cat. Use but to tell us about both pets. Start with Mia.
Mia has a dog, but Tom has a cat.
Lina has a home in a small apartment. Tell us where she lives in a full sentence.
Lina lives in a small apartment.
Now Lina and Noah share the small apartment. Tell us where they live. Start with Lina and Noah.
Lina and Noah live in a small apartment.
Read the home card. Find and fix one wrong word.
Lina lives in a big house.
The home card says small apartment. Where does Lina live? Start with Lina and use a full sentence.
Lina lives in a small apartment.
Her home is on a quiet street. Start with Lina lives and describe the street.
Lina lives on a quiet street.
The home card says big house. Where does Noah live? Start with Noah and use a full sentence.
Noah lives in a big house.
Cars are loud all night, and you cannot sleep. Describe the problem with this street. Use too and end with for me.
The street is too noisy for me.
Now the street is quiet at night, and you sleep well. Change the old sentence to show that the noise is not a problem. Use too in your answer.
The street is not too noisy for me.
Cars move very fast, and crossing this road is not safe. Find and fix one wrong word.
This road is too dangerous for me.
Cars are loud all night, and you cannot sleep. Start with It is too and end with for me.
It is too noisy for me.
Nothing happens in this game, and you feel bored. Start with It is too and end with for me.
It is too boring for me.
Cars move very fast, and crossing here is not safe. Start with It is too and end with for me.
It is too dangerous for me.
You enjoy apples, but you do not enjoy cheese. Tell us both food choices in one sentence. Start with I like apples.
I like apples, but I don't like cheese.
Before, you liked cheese. Now you do not enjoy it. Change the sentence to show your new choice.
I don't like cheese.
Find and fix one wrong word in this food sentence.
I don't like corn.
You enjoy apples, but you do not enjoy cheese. Tell us both choices, starting with I like. Use but.
I like apples, but I don't like cheese.
You enjoy cookies, but you do not enjoy corn. Tell us both choices, starting with I like. Use but.
I like cookies, but I don't like corn.
Cheese is not a food you enjoy. Start with I do not and use a full sentence.
I don't like cheese.
